properties.name: Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine Ratio
properties.definition: UACR is a ratio between two measured substances. Unlike a dipstick test for albumin, UACR is unaffected by variation in urine concentration.

quote: Albuminuria1 is present when UACR is greater than 30 mg/g and is a marker for CKD.

properties.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate
properties.definition: eGFR is more accurate than serum creatinine alone. Serum creatinine is affected by muscle mass, and related factors of age, sex, and race.

quote: Calculate eGFR from stable serum creatinine levels at least once a year in all patients with diabetes.
